# Basketball: Hardwood StatScout

> Hardwood StatScout is an NBA advanced stats app for iPhone that ranks every player on percentiles for usage, true shooting, shot zones and impact. No account.

## App

- [NBA Advanced Stats App | Basketball: Hardwood StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/basketball/index.html.md): Hardwood StatScout is an NBA advanced stats app for iPhone that ranks every player on percentiles for usage, true shooting, shot zones and impact. No account.

## Guides

- [What Is a Good True Shooting Percentage? (TS% Formula)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/basketball/true-shooting-percentage-explained.html.md): A .581 TS% was league average in 2025-26 and .641 put a player in the top 10%. See the true shooting formula, a worked example, and how usage rate fits in.
